definitions.gloss: one after another, in quick succession
definitions.explanation: Describes doing something continuously and without pause, often implying abundance or lack of restraint.

examples.japanese: {注文|ちゅうもん}がじゃんじゃん{入|はい}ってきた。
examples.english: Orders came pouring in one after another.

examples.japanese: じゃんじゃんお{金|かね}を{使|つか}う。
examples.english: To spend money freely without restraint.

examples.japanese: {質問|しつもん}があればじゃんじゃん{聞|き}いてください。
examples.english: If you have questions, please ask away!

examples.japanese: {新製品|しんせいひん}をじゃんじゃん{開発|かいはつ}している。
examples.english: They're developing new products one after another.

notes:
じゃんじゃん is an onomatopoeic adverb suggesting the sound of continuous action (like a ringing bell or cymbal). It implies doing something freely, abundantly, and without hesitation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・じゃんじゃん{使|つか}う (use freely/spend freely)
・じゃんじゃん{来|く}る (come pouring in)
・じゃんじゃん{言|い}う/{聞|き}く (speak/ask without hesitation)
・じゃんじゃんやる (do without restraint)

REGISTER: Casual/colloquial. Often used in spoken Japanese.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・どんどん: One after another (neutral)
・ばんばん: Vigorously, without hesitation
・じゃんじゃん: Freely, abundantly (implies no restraint)
